question: MQIL is related to FJBE in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, OSKN is related to HLDG. To which of the given options is QUMP related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

 The pattern can be summarized as **(-7, -7, -7, -7)**.

**
**Pair 1: MQIL : FJBE**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7cd402fd8976731d7c0452864e013ca7be452343d11690f42ab1eafb1ece84e6.png] 

**Pair 2: OSKN : HLDG**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa541d67c0169d27bdd81e2a7f96c20e32ef266f94053e1d76ef620de14a7edb.png] 

**Applying the same logic to QUMP:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acb5677582700f16c1039575d89c8435c118e4f9a29d810fb97a034dadcb62f1.png] 

Thus, QUMP is related to JNFI.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"**.
